Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS) total score: sum of eight items scored 0–3, total range 0–24; higher scores indicate greater daytime sleep propensity. Baseline is enrollment/randomization. The selected primary per-protocol endpoint is change from baseline to 3 months after diagnostic consultation; this is distinct from 3 months after randomization.

population.population_definition: Randomized allocation to at-home mandibular jaw movement monitoring (MJM) with AI-supported analysis versus polysomnography; randomized 1:1.; Adults aged 18–80 years referred for suspicion of OSA, randomized to the MJM arm. population.population_time_frame: Randomization 28 October 2021 to 7 October 2024; baseline at enrolment/randomization.
